analysis.summary: In its annual report for FY 2024-25, Vikram Thermo reported that revenue from continuing operations increased to Rs. 12,623.06 Lakhs, while profit after tax decreased to Rs. 809.85 Lakhs primarily due to the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals business. The demerger of the Aromatic Chemicals business into Vikram Aroma Limited became effective on May 4, 2024, and its shares commenced trading on March 6, 2025. The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 10% (Rs.

guidance.claim: The company is committed to driving profitable revenue growth by developing and commercializing high-margin, research-driven products.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company's strategic focus is to build a sustainable business model targeting profitable revenue growth and launching high-margin research-based products.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: As the company enters fiscal 2024, it plans to continue its transformation by entering new markets with favorable competition and working on new, complex products.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

guidance.claim: The company intends to leverage its R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and customer-centric products to reach new heights.
guidance.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

demand_outlook.claim: The company aims to continuously enhance its product portfolio to meet dynamic market demands.
demand_outlook.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's nationwide presence and expanding global footprint have yielded positive results.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company did not make any capital expenditure on research and development during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: the expenditure incurred on Research and Development Capital Expenditure - Nil

capex_expansion.claim: Shares of the resulting company Vikram Aroma Limited have been allotted following the demerger scheme and are awaiting final listing approval.
capex_expansion.quote: The equity shares of resulting company M/s Vikram Aroma Limited have already been allotted to the shareholders of your company and we are awaiting the final approval of BSE/SEBI for the listing/trading of the shares of Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved a scheme of arrangement to demerge its Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

margins_costs.claim: The company's profit after tax decreased to Rs. 809.85 Lakhs compared to Rs. 2,537.87 Lakhs in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT decreased to Rs. 809.85 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 2537.87 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

margins_costs.claim: The decrease in profit after tax was primarily due to the demerger of a business unit.
margins_costs.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating income grew by 20.95% and profits after tax increased by 94.59% in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating income grew to Rs. 112.89 crores, a growth of 20.95% as compared to the previous FY 2022, Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

margins_costs.claim: The average remuneration of employees excluding whole-time directors and managerial persons increased by 31.10% during FY 2022-23.
margins_costs.quote: The average remuneration of employees excluding the whole time Directors and managerial persons increased by 31.10% during the financial year 2022-23 as compared to the aggregate increase of 71.43% in the remuneration of the whole time directors and other key managerial persons.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 10% on equity shares, amounting to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed dividend payout will result in a total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount to its reserves from the profit of the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not make any loans, guarantees, or investments under Section 186 during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review there are no loans, guarantees or investments under section 186 made by the company.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 7.5% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend payout for the year will amount to Rs. 2,35,18,388.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will result in a total outflow of Rs. 1,56,78,925.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs.1,56,78,925/- (Previous Year Rs.94,07,355/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during the financial year 2022-23.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2022-23.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 2,50,86,280 bonus shares of Rs. 10 each on May 14, 2022.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's risk identification process covers areas such as business strategy, operations, cyber security, and financial reporting.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The demerger of the aromatic chemicals business is expected to help isolate risks between the respective businesses.
risks_headwinds.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's risk framework evaluates internal and external risks including readiness for extreme disasters.
risks_headwinds.quote: The process involves identifying both external and internal risks and the readiness to respond to extreme risks like calamities and disasters.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has implemented a Risk Management Policy to identify external and internal risks that may threaten its existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to driving profitable revenue growth by developing and commercializing high-margin, research-driven products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to consistent investment in R&D and continuous enhancement of its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The Board of Directors is committed to steering the organization for long-term success while keeping the company on a path of sustainable growth.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of your Company are fully committed to steering the organization for long-term success through setting of strategies, delegating responsibilities and providing an overall direction to the business, while effectively managing risks and ensuring high quality of governance by keeping the Company on the path of Sustainable growth and development.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to consistent investment in R&D and expanding its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: As the company enters fiscal 2024, it will continue its transformation by entering new markets and working on new, complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to spending an appropriate amount towards its CSR obligation for the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The company is pleased to inform the members that an amount of Rs. 33,69,000 towards its CSR obligation for 2022-23 has been spent which is over and above the requirement as specified by the Government and it is committed to further spend appropriate amount towards its obligation of the current financial year during 2022-23 as well.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
